chapterInfo.content:
11
Paulo dɔ
1Anka monhunu me nkwaseasɛm ma me kakra ɛ! Monte me aseɛ. 2#Efe 5.26-27 Na ninkunu a metwe no mo ho no, metwe no Nyankopɔn mu ninkunu. Magye mo awadeɛ sɛ ababaawa a efi nkaa no; na mede mo rekɔma ɔbarima baako a ɔno ne Kristo. 3#Gye 3.4; 3.13 Nanso mesuro sɛ ebia, sɛdeɛ ɔwɔ no de n’aniteɛ bɛdaadaa Hawa no, saa ara nso na wɔbɛsɛe mo adwene afiri Kristo fam ahofama no ho. 4#Gal 1.8-9 Na sɛ obi ba bɛka Yesu foforɔ bi ho asɛm a yɛnkaeɛ, anaasɛ monya honhom foforɔ a monnyaeɛ, anaasɛ asɛmpa foforɔ a monnyeeɛ a, mogye tomu ntɛm so! 5#2 Ko 12.11; 1 Ko 15.10; Gal 2.6; 2.9 Nanso mebu no sɛ asomafoɔ akɛseɛ no nkyɛn me biribiara mu. 6#1 Ko 2.1-2; 2.13; Efe 3.4 Nanso sɛ mennim ɔkasa mu mpo a, ɛnyɛ nimdeɛ, na mmom yɛama biribiara ada adi ama mo, nnipa nyinaa anim.
Paulo asɛmpa som animuonyam ne n’atamfo animguaseɛ
7 # 1 Ko 9.12; 9.18 Anaasɛ mayɛ bɔne, sɛ mebrɛɛ me ho ase maa wɔmaa mo soɔ, sɛ mekaa Nyankopɔn asɛmpa no kyerɛɛ mo kwa no? 8#Flp 4.10; 4.15 Mefaa asafo binom adeɛ sɛ akatua, sɛ mede merebɛsom mo. 9#2 Ko 12.13 Na mewɔ mo nkyɛn na ɛhiaa me no, manyɛ obiara so adesoa. Na deɛ ɛhiaa me no, anuanom a wɔfiri Makedonia baeɛ no maa me nsa kaeɛ; na nnoɔma nyinaa mu, mehwɛɛ me ho, na mɛhwɛ no saa ara, na manyɛ adesoa mamma mo. 10#1 Ko 9.15 Kristo nokorɛ wɔ me mu yi, obiara remma me mmua m’ano saa ahohoahoa yi ho wɔ Akaia afam hɔnom nyinaa. 11Adɛn ntira? Sɛ mennɔ mo anaa? Onyankopɔn na ɔnim. 12Na deɛ meyɛ no, meyɛ ara, na masi wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ me ho kwan no kwan, na wɔahu wɔn deɛ wɔde hoahoa wɔn ho no mu, sɛ yɛn ara. 13#2 Ko 2.17; Flp 3.2 Na saa nnipa yi yɛ asomafoɔ atorofoɔ, adwumayɛfoɔ nnaadaafoɔ a wɔdane wɔn ho yɛ sɛ Kristo asomafoɔ. 14Na ɛnyɛ nwanwa; ɛfiri sɛ Satan no ara mpo dane ne ho sɛ hann bɔfoɔ. 15Enti sɛ n’asomafoɔ nso dane wɔn ho yɛ sɛ tenenee asomfoɔ a, ɛnyɛ ade nwanwa biara; na ɛbɛwie wɔn sɛdeɛ wɔn nnwuma teɛ.
Paulo ahohoahoa no anoyie
16 # 2 Ko 12.6 Meka bio sɛ obiara mmmu me sɛ meyɛ kwasea, na sɛ ɛnte saa a, monnye me sɛ ɔkwasea, na me nso mahoahoa me ho kakra. 17Deɛ mereka no, menka no Awurade tumi mu, na mmom nkwaseasɛm mu, saa ahohoahoa adwene yi mu. 18Ɛsiane sɛ nnipa bebree hoahoa wɔn ho honam fam nti, me nso mɛhoahoa me ho bi. 19Na mode anigyeɛ nya tema ma nkwaseafoɔ, ɛfiri sɛ moyɛ mmadwemma. 20Na sɛ obi di mo nya, sɛ obi didi mo ho, sɛ obi fa mo dommum, sɛ obi ma ne ho so, sɛ obi bɔ mo ani so a, mobɛhunu ama no.
Paulo asiane ne ne brɛ
21Meka no aniwuo mu sɛ yɛn deɛ yɛayɛ mmerɛ wɔ mu; nanso deɛ obi yɛ nnam wɔ mu no, (meka no sɛ deɛ aba biara nni mu,) me nso meyɛ nnam wɔ mu bi. 22#Flp 3.5 Wɔyɛ Hebrifoɔ? Me nso meyɛ bi. Wɔyɛ Israelfoɔ? Me nso meyɛ bi. Wɔyɛ Abraham asefoɔ? Me nso meyɛ bi. 23#1 Ko 15.10 Wɔyɛ Kristo asomfo? Meka no sɛ ɛdammɔ, mekyɛne saa. Ɔbrɛ adwuma a ɛboro soɔ mu, afiaseda a ɛboro soɔ mu, ɛhweɛ a ɛtra soɔ mu, owuo amaneɛ a manya no nhunuiɛ mu. 24#Deut 25.3 Yudafoɔ nsa mu wɔabɔ me mmaa aduanan a aka so baako, mprenum. 25#Aso 16.22; 14.19 Wɔaka me mpire mprɛnsa, wɔasi me aboɔ prɛko, matɔ nsuo mu mprɛnsa, madi ɛpo bunu mu adekyeeɛ ne adesaeɛ. 26Akwantuo pii mu, asubɔnten so asiane mu, adwotwafoɔ asiane mu, amannifoɔ mu asiane mu, amanaman mu asiane mu, kuro mu asiane mu, ɛserɛ so asiane mu, ɛpo so asiane mu, anuanom atorofoɔ mu asiane mu; 27#2 Ko 6.5 adwuma ne ɔbrɛ mu, apɛsire mu, ɛkɔm ne sukɔm mu, abuada pii mu, awɔ ne adagya mu. 28#Aso 20.18-21 Deɛ ɛkeka ho no nyinaa nna nkyɛn, deɛ ɛhyɛ me soɔ ne asafo no nyinaa ho dadwene. 29#1 Ko 9.22 Hwan na ɔyɛ mmerɛ, na menyɛ mmerɛ bie? Hwan na wɔato no suntidua, na me yamu nhyehye me?
30 # 2 Ko 12.5 Sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ mehoahoa me ho a, mɛhoahoa me ho wɔ me mmerɛyɛ ho. 31#2 Ko 1.23 Awurade Yesu Nyankopɔn ne n’Agya a nhyira nka no daa no nim sɛ merenni atorɔ.
Dwane a Paulo dwane firii Damasko
32Damasko hɔ na Ɔhene Areta n’amrado wɛnn Damaskofoɔ kuro no sɛ ɔrepɛ me akyere me; 33#Aso 9.24-25 na wɔde me too kɛntɛnku mu nam mpomma mu faa ɔfasuo so gyaagyaa me maa mefirii ne nsa medwanee.

Anka monhunu me nkwaseasɛm ma me kakra ɛ! Monte me aseɛ. Na ninkunu a metwe no mo ho no, metwe no Nyankopɔn mu ninkunu. Magye mo awadeɛ sɛ ababaawa a efi nkaa no; na mede mo rekɔma ɔbarima baako a ɔno ne Kristo. Nanso mesuro sɛ ebia, sɛdeɛ ɔwɔ no de n’aniteɛ bɛdaadaa Hawa no, saa ara nso na wɔbɛsɛe mo adwene afiri Kristo fam ahofama no ho. Na sɛ obi ba bɛka Yesu foforɔ bi ho asɛm a yɛnkaeɛ, anaasɛ monya honhom foforɔ a monnyaeɛ, anaasɛ asɛmpa foforɔ a monnyeeɛ a, mogye tomu ntɛm so! Nanso mebu no sɛ asomafoɔ akɛseɛ no nkyɛn me biribiara mu. Nanso sɛ mennim ɔkasa mu mpo a, ɛnyɛ nimdeɛ, na mmom yɛama biribiara ada adi ama mo, nnipa nyinaa anim.

Anaasɛ mayɛ bɔne, sɛ mebrɛɛ me ho ase maa wɔmaa mo soɔ, sɛ mekaa Nyankopɔn asɛmpa no kyerɛɛ mo kwa no? Mefaa asafo binom adeɛ sɛ akatua, sɛ mede merebɛsom mo. Na mewɔ mo nkyɛn na ɛhiaa me no, manyɛ obiara so adesoa. Na deɛ ɛhiaa me no, anuanom a wɔfiri Makedonia baeɛ no maa me nsa kaeɛ; na nnoɔma nyinaa mu, mehwɛɛ me ho, na mɛhwɛ no saa ara, na manyɛ adesoa mamma mo. Kristo nokorɛ wɔ me mu yi, obiara remma me mmua m’ano saa ahohoahoa yi ho wɔ Akaia afam hɔnom nyinaa. Adɛn ntira? Sɛ mennɔ mo anaa? Onyankopɔn na ɔnim. Na deɛ meyɛ no, meyɛ ara, na masi wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ me ho kwan no kwan, na wɔahu wɔn deɛ wɔde hoahoa wɔn ho no mu, sɛ yɛn ara. Na saa nnipa yi yɛ asomafoɔ atorofoɔ, adwumayɛfoɔ nnaadaafoɔ a wɔdane wɔn ho yɛ sɛ Kristo asomafoɔ. Na ɛnyɛ nwanwa; ɛfiri sɛ Satan no ara mpo dane ne ho sɛ hann bɔfoɔ. Enti sɛ n’asomafoɔ nso dane wɔn ho yɛ sɛ tenenee asomfoɔ a, ɛnyɛ ade nwanwa biara; na ɛbɛwie wɔn sɛdeɛ wɔn nnwuma teɛ.

Meka bio sɛ obiara mmmu me sɛ meyɛ kwasea, na sɛ ɛnte saa a, monnye me sɛ ɔkwasea, na me nso mahoahoa me ho kakra. Deɛ mereka no, menka no Awurade tumi mu, na mmom nkwaseasɛm mu, saa ahohoahoa adwene yi mu. Ɛsiane sɛ nnipa bebree hoahoa wɔn ho honam fam nti, me nso mɛhoahoa me ho bi. Na mode anigyeɛ nya tema ma nkwaseafoɔ, ɛfiri sɛ moyɛ mmadwemma. Na sɛ obi di mo nya, sɛ obi didi mo ho, sɛ obi fa mo dommum, sɛ obi ma ne ho so, sɛ obi bɔ mo ani so a, mobɛhunu ama no.

Meka no aniwuo mu sɛ yɛn deɛ yɛayɛ mmerɛ wɔ mu; nanso deɛ obi yɛ nnam wɔ mu no, (meka no sɛ deɛ aba biara nni mu,) me nso meyɛ nnam wɔ mu bi. Wɔyɛ Hebrifoɔ? Me nso meyɛ bi. Wɔyɛ Israelfoɔ? Me nso meyɛ bi. Wɔyɛ Abraham asefoɔ? Me nso meyɛ bi. Wɔyɛ Kristo asomfo? Meka no sɛ ɛdammɔ, mekyɛne saa. Ɔbrɛ adwuma a ɛboro soɔ mu, afiaseda a ɛboro soɔ mu, ɛhweɛ a ɛtra soɔ mu, owuo amaneɛ a manya no nhunuiɛ mu. Yudafoɔ nsa mu wɔabɔ me mmaa aduanan a aka so baako, mprenum. Wɔaka me mpire mprɛnsa, wɔasi me aboɔ prɛko, matɔ nsuo mu mprɛnsa, madi ɛpo bunu mu adekyeeɛ ne adesaeɛ. Akwantuo pii mu, asubɔnten so asiane mu, adwotwafoɔ asiane mu, amannifoɔ mu asiane mu, amanaman mu asiane mu, kuro mu asiane mu, ɛserɛ so asiane mu, ɛpo so asiane mu, anuanom atorofoɔ mu asiane mu; adwuma ne ɔbrɛ mu, apɛsire mu, ɛkɔm ne sukɔm mu, abuada pii mu, awɔ ne adagya mu. Deɛ ɛkeka ho no nyinaa nna nkyɛn, deɛ ɛhyɛ me soɔ ne asafo no nyinaa ho dadwene. Hwan na ɔyɛ mmerɛ, na menyɛ mmerɛ bie? Hwan na wɔato no suntidua, na me yamu nhyehye me?
Sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ mehoahoa me ho a, mɛhoahoa me ho wɔ me mmerɛyɛ ho. Awurade Yesu Nyankopɔn ne n’Agya a nhyira nka no daa no nim sɛ merenni atorɔ.

Damasko hɔ na Ɔhene Areta n’amrado wɛnn Damaskofoɔ kuro no sɛ ɔrepɛ me akyere me; na wɔde me too kɛntɛnku mu nam mpomma mu faa ɔfasuo so gyaagyaa me maa mefirii ne nsa medwanee.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
